end.summary:
- Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
- Om described standing lines as going upward and slanting lines as leaning to one side.
- They recognised that a line can be straight even when it is slanting.
- 2 of 4 responses were unaided correct; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Om practised sorting lines by direction and noticing that “straight” means a line does not bend, while standing, sleeping, and slanting describe its position. They explained standing and slanting lines with examples such as poles and slides. There was a mix-up about a slide being both slanting and straight, and it was corrected later when Om said it is a slanting straight line. At home, ask Om to find one standing, one sleeping, and one slanting straight line around the room.
